product.name: 7shifts Scheduling
product.description: Restaurant workforce scheduling software for creating shifts, managing availability and time-off requests, coordinating shift swaps, forecasting demand, and monitoring labor costs and compliance.

product.name: 7shifts Pay
product.description: Restaurant payroll and compensation software that connects time records and tips to wage calculations, payroll processing, tax filing, compliance workflows, and earned wage access.

product.name: 7shifts Engage
product.description: Restaurant employee engagement and performance software for collecting feedback, reviewing attendance and performance information, communicating with teams, and supporting manager-led coaching.

product.name: 7shifts Hiring
product.description: Restaurant hiring and onboarding software for posting jobs, tracking applicants, and sending and storing digital onboarding documents before an employee's first shift.

product.name: 7shifts Training
product.description: Restaurant employee training software for converting operational materials into courses, creating quizzes and acknowledgements, assigning learning, and tracking completion across roles and locations.

product.name: Employee Training
product.description: A restaurant-specific employee training solution built into 7shifts for creating, assigning, and tracking workforce training.
